blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Diversity means people are different. In a good company, everyone is welcome. Women and men, young and older people, people from many countries and many backgrounds — all are part of the team.

Inclusion means everyone has a place. Nobody feels alone. Everyone can speak, and everyone is heard.

This is called DEI: diversity, equity and inclusion. Equity means we give people what they need to succeed. A diverse team is a strong team.

items.q: What does diversity mean, according to the text?
items.why: "Diversity means people are different."

items.q: What does inclusion mean?
items.why: "Inclusion means everyone has a place. Nobody feels alone."

items.q: What does DEI stand for?
items.why: "This is called DEI: diversity, equity and inclusion."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: One country is better than others
Only similar people work well together
A team of different people can be strong
items.why: Inferência: "A diverse team is a strong team" — o texto vê a diferença como uma força.

items.q: "Nobody feels alone" suggests that in this team…
options: People feel part of the group
items.why: Inferência: se ninguém se sente só, todos se sentem parte do grupo — é a ideia de inclusão.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie no seu workshop de DEI. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Welcome to our workshop today. Please sit down and feel at home. This is a safe place, and everyone here is welcome.

Today we talk about three words: diversity, equity and inclusion. Diversity is simple. It means we are different. We come from many countries. We have different ages and different backgrounds. And that is a good thing. A team of different people is a strong team.

Now, inclusion. Inclusion means everyone has a place here. Nobody is left behind. Everyone can speak, and everyone is heard. Your voice is important. When we make a decision, we listen to everyone.

And equity. Equity means we give people what they need. Not everyone needs the same help. But everyone deserves an equal chance to succeed.

So please, this morning, share your ideas. Do not be shy. Every idea is welcome here.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does Sophie describe the room at the start?
options: A place to work in silence
A safe place where everyone is welcome
items.why: "This is a safe place, and everyone here is welcome."

items.q: What three words does Sophie talk about?
items.why: "Today we talk about three words: diversity, equity and inclusion."

items.q: What does Sophie say inclusion means?
options: Everyone has a place and is heard
items.why: "Inclusion means everyone has a place here… everyone can speak, and everyone is heard."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "Not everyone needs the same help"?
options: Because equity means giving people what they need
Because the team is very big
items.why: Inferência: ela explica equidade — dar a cada um o que precisa, não o mesmo para todos.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela recebe o grupo, pede ideias e diz que todos são bem-vindos — um tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our team has people from ten countries. We love this diversity." Diversity means…
items.why: Diversity = diversidade: as pessoas são diferentes.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "New here? Don't worry — you are ___."
items.why: Welcome = bem-vindo, a palavra certa para receber alguém.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "In our meetings, ___ can speak. We listen to all people."
items.why: Everyone = todos: a frase diz que todas as pessoas podem falar.

items.q: "Every person deserves an equal chance." Equal means…
items.why: Equal = igual: a mesma chance para todos.

items.q: "Tell us your idea. Your voice is important." Voice here means…
items.why: Voice = voz: aqui é a sua opinião, o direito de falar e ser ouvido.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please speak up in the meeting." To speak up means to…
items.why: Speak up = falar, dizer a sua opinião — não ficar calado.

items.q: "We will roll out the new DEI plan next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, lançar o plano.

items.q: "In our team, nobody is left behind." To be left behind means to be…
items.why: Left behind = deixado para trás, esquecido ou excluído.

items.q: "Everyone can take part in the project." To take part means to…
items.why: Take part = participar, entrar e ajudar.

items.q: "Come in and feel at home." To feel at home means to feel…
items.why: Feel at home = sentir-se à vontade, confortável e bem-vindo.
